content: {"episode_id":"ep-05099","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93247, long-term continuous electrocardiographic monitoring, for episode ep-05099. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9, Z86.73). Per the note, given the concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion, long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances."}
